versions.content: Configuration of CanIf_SetTrcvMode() : The number of supported transceiver types for each network is set up in the configuration phase (see CanIfTrcvCfg and CanIfTrcvDrvCfg ). If no transceiver is used, this function may be omitted. Therefore, if no transceiver is configured in LT or PB class the API shall return with E_NOT_OK .
